notes: Access: HTTP tier (curl/WebFetch) was blocked by Akamai edge (403 Access Denied on both robots.txt and homepage). Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3). robots.txt (fetched via browser) has NO Claude-specific disallow (generic 'User-agent: *' block only) so browser access is permitted; it explicitly disallows crawler access to */search, */collection/*, /*/clp/*, and /*/facet_collection/* paths -- i.e. Meesho itself treats these as non-canonical dynamic pages, not stable categories. Investigated the real Home & Kitchen taxonomy: the mega-menu (Home & Kitchen -> 5 sub-heads: Home Decor, Kitchen & Appliances, Home Textiles, Home Improvement, Furniture) was opened and each sub-head's full 'View All' subcategory list was read. None of the ~70 total subcategory nodes across all 5 sub-heads is holiday/festival-branded (no Christmas, Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, New Year, Eid, Navratri, etc. anywhere in the primary navigation). The Home Decor category's full filter list (48 subcategories, expanded via 'Show More') was also checked -- closest items are generic religious/festive product-TYPE categories used year-round across multiple occasions, not branded to one holiday: 'Puja Articles'/'Pooja Needs', 'Diyas & Lanterns', 'Party Supplies', 'Agarbatti Holders'/'Agarbatti Sticks'. Per the seasonal ruleset (Diyas & Lanterns/Puja items are general religious-use product types, not a site-branded 'Diwali' category), these do not qualify. Tested search-autosuggest for 'Diwali': suggestions were pure query strings (diwali ghadi, diwali sticker, diwali lightings, diwali decorations, diwali & other festivals, diwali dress) with no category link. Clicking through to 'diwali decorations', 'christmas decorations', 'raksha bandhan decorations', and 'holi decorations' each resolved only to the generic /search?q=... endpoint (the same endpoint robots.txt disallows to crawlers), each returning a MIXED bag of unrelated products (wall decor, bangles, earrings, dupatta sets, kids party items, candle holders) rather than a curated, single-topic category -- proof these are keyword text search, not real PLP categories. Notably, the 'christmas decorations' search did show a single-value 'Category: Christmas Decorations' filter tag (an internal seller-facing classification value -- 7 of the 20 results were literally titled '[Adjective] Christmas Decorations', Meesho's standard auto-title pattern of [Adjective]+[CategoryName]), indicating sellers can tag a product with this internal category label, but there is NO dedicated, navigable PLP/category URL for it anywhere on the site -- it is reachable only through the /search?q= endpoint, is absent from the mega-menu, and the PDP of a Christmas product carries no breadcrumb back to any category page. This fails the 'has its own valid PLP/category URL' test (rules module Sec 20.4) the same way Flipkart/Myntra/AJIO's search-driven pseudo-categories did in prior batches of this project. The homepage's SEO footer link block (a flat list of trending search terms, not navigation) also surfaced one stray 'Diwali Lightings' term, but this sits under the Electronics & Accessories footer group, not Home & Kitchen, and out of Home & Kitchen scope regardless; it likewise resolves to a search page, not a category. Conclusion: Meesho's real, stable Home & Kitchen taxonomy (mega-menu + full category filter trees) contains no genuine seasonal/holiday category node for Christmas, Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, New Year, Eid, or any other festival -- only generic year-round religious/festive product-type categories (Puja Articles, Diyas & Lanterns, Party Supplies) and search-driven holiday keyword results, both correctly excluded per the marketing/search-page exclusion rules. No Mother's Day/Father's Day category present either (checked same mega-menu/filter trees; absent). Recorded as NO_SEASONAL with rows: [].
